title: Chapter 119
text:
After making up his mind, Han Xiao started to work on it.

The technology of kinetic energy weapons was an important part of a civilization's military power, and light weapons were even more important.

The theory behind electromagnetic energy weapons was not complicated. They used electromagnetic force to propel the bullet, but the actual adjustment was very difficult. The number of coil turns, the strength of the current, the limitation of the energy source, the acceleration distance, and so on were all difficult points.

[Basic Energy Theory] had reached Level 5, and Han Xiao was given a new blueprint. It was a new type of energy battery — the Basic Energy Storage Cube. The players called it the 'Rubik's Cube'. It was a precise square structure that could store 180 Ona of energy. It was most suitable for storing electricity, and its capacity was many times that of a normal high-energy battery.

The Six Nations were researching other types of high-performance batteries in their laboratories, such as power batteries, superconducting batteries, and even miniature nuclear batteries (which had not been developed yet). They were suitable for different purposes, and the Rubik's Cube was a type of battery that mechanics were used to because it was convenient and fast.

The same theory had countless practical possibilities. The future of technology was not fixed, and different civilizations had their own technological trends. For example, when we talk about long-range cold weapons in ancient times, most people would think of crossbows. But let's assume that if the ancient people developed another type of long-range cold weapon (not a crossbow), then the common sense that we now think of as a foregone conclusion would also change accordingly. When it comes to long-range cold weapons, we would no longer think of crossbows.

Therefore, the different possibilities of technology were very interesting.

As for your question, if the ancient people did not develop crossbows, what would they develop?

Cough, the main point was the thought process.

Self-creation failed.

Self-creation failed.

Han Xiao continued to experiment and failed time after time. He kept perfecting the details.

"It's almost evening now."

Han Xiao looked at the sky and felt that it was a pity. He could only stop his work and prepare to gather.

Antonio walked in leisurely. "Someone from Division 13 came to look for you."

"What did he say?"

"Your employer adjusted the gathering time and told you not to rush over. You just have to return to River Valley Manor before tomorrow morning."

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. This was good. He would have time to continue building.

…

Night time.

Wang Yuan and the other two sat in the car. It was a smooth journey back to the manor.

Wang Yuan and Bennett entered the villa and returned to the room on the top floor. After closing the door, only the two of them were left in the room.

"Xena has locked onto all the traitors and is currently hunting them down. The bait operation this time was very successful. As long as the traitors are eliminated, the organization can start implementing your idea." Wang Yuan's expression was serious.

Bennett nodded solemnly. "I have a feeling that war will break out again sooner or later. We need to build shelters as soon as possible. The Dark Net's power is far from enough to complete the plan. I hope there will be more forces and organizations willing to cooperate with us."

"I don't know about the other powers, but the Six Nations will definitely agree." Wang Yuan said in a deep voice, "You saw Mo Ran's attitude during the discussion. Stardragon's upper echelons won't oppose your plan. This is good news for the Six Nations, and it's good news for all the displaced people in the world. As long as we get the help of the Six Nations, we will definitely be able to build the sanctuary … I'm just afraid that some ambitious people will covet our resources. "

Bennett's eyes flashed, and a faint flame of arrogance rose in his eyes. His tone was like the cold wind that blew through the north. "This is a plan that can save countless lives. I will chop up whoever dares to extend their claws!"

Wang Yuan was about to speak when an ear-piercing sound of electricity suddenly came from outside the manor, followed by a loud rumble.

The two of them looked out the window. A thick blue lightning bolt shot into the sky outside the manor, as if it was a lightning bolt that split the sky from the ground! A large black object was blown away by the lightning bolt and smashed into an armored vehicle.

It was the entrance of the manor!

Bai Jin, whose body was surrounded by bright lightning, walked over from afar. He was the one who had fired that stunning bolt of lightning from 200 meters away. The gate of the manor, which had withstood countless cannon fire, was blown away by that bolt of lightning!

Bai Jin did not care about sneaking in. He preferred to crush his enemies head-on.

The mercenaries yelled and hurriedly controlled their machine guns and howitzers to counterattack. Bai Jin had a look of disdain on his face. Electricity burst out from under his feet, and his entire body was sent flying more than ten meters into the air. The spot where he was originally standing was bombarded by the rain of steel bullets.

In the air, Bai Jin clenched his fists and straightened them, facing a machine gun platform on the southeast wall of the manor. An even more dazzling electric light spread from his chest to his fists, and a thick, spiral-shaped electric light suddenly burst out, leaving a burning mark on the retinas of all the mercenaries.

"Boom!"

The wall where the machine gun platform was located directly exploded, and the other machine gun platforms and howitzers around it were also affected. The few mercenaries who were hit did not even have time to say a word before they were turned into charcoal in the blink of an eye. The smell was pungent, and thick smoke rose from them.

The power of this attack shocked all the mercenaries. A chill ran from their tailbones to their heads, and their scalps went numb.

No one could take Bai Jin's attack head-on. Volcano, Moonlight, and the others were all dead, and Mr. Black was not around. There was no expert in the manor who could defend against such a strong enemy!

"We can't deal with a Super of this level!" Some of the mercenaries had the thought of retreating.

Chen Li's eyes flashed fiercely, and he gave the order to try attacking again.

At this time, Bai Jin landed on the ground. The height of more than ten meters did not injure him at all. Seeing that the mercenaries still had the will to fight, his expression turned cold. "You overestimate yourselves."

After saying that, he raised his hands and slammed his palms forward. An invisible electromagnetic pulse spread out in front of him, and all the electronic components in the manor emitted crackling sounds. All of them were damaged, and the place turned dark.

The mercenaries were shocked. Even the cars were destroyed, and they could not escape!

Despair.

The darkness spread rapidly.

The villa also turned dark. Wang Yuan looked at Bai Jin with a solemn expression. "Lightning's Bai Jin. His Esper Ability is self-generation, and he can control lightning. His potential level is very high. He is a super criminal who has been very active in recent years."

"He's just a young man who squanders his talent. The guys outside can't stop him. Let me do it."

Bennett's expression did not change. He opened the window and jumped from the roof to the ground. He walked past the panicking mercenaries and walked toward Bai Jin. His aura suddenly increased, and he instantly caught everyone's attention. Only then did the mercenaries notice this person who had been keeping a low profile beside Wang Yuan. They were shocked, and hope appeared in their hearts again.

"Hmm? There's actually a powerful guy hiding here! " Bai Jin sensed Bennett's aura and licked his lips excitedly. He then activated all the electricity stored in his body and was ready to attack.

"No matter how many weaklings I kill, it will not give me as much pleasure as killing a strong one."

Bai Jin's eyes were extremely arrogant, and he stared at Bennett like a hungry wolf.

…

The car of Division 13 was hidden in the forest far away, monitoring the manor from afar.

Di Su Su secretly broke out in a cold sweat. The destructive power displayed by Bai Jin was too shocking. It was a destructive Esper Ability against a military grade Esper.

"I have to report this to Officer Mo as soon as possible. If a super criminal of this level has any designs on Seagull City, the consequences will be unimaginable." Di Su Su picked up the phone and was about to call Mo Ran.

On the surveillance screen, the auras of Bennett and Bai Jin were at the peak. The atmosphere was tense, and a fierce battle between powerful Supers was about to break out at any time!

Just as everyone held their breaths, at this critical moment …

A thick cloud of blood suddenly burst out of Bai Jin's chest.

Then, everyone heard a strange gunshot from afar.
